entities.summary: Linos-Spyridon Chrysikopoulos is a Greek professional basketball player for Kolossos Rodou of the Greek Basketball League. He is 6 ft 9 in (2.06 m) tall and 225 pounds (102 kg). He plays at the power forward position and his nickname is Spider-Man.
